title: Copilot Studio – Use the Decision model in the Classify node in Workflows
body:
We are announcing the ability to choose Decision models in Classify nodes within a workflow in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on November 19, 2026.  

How does this affect me?

Makers can choose a decision model in the Classify node for more efficient, higher volume classification. You can define categories and descriptions as you do today, and Category-based branching, outputs, and the automatic Other category will continue to work.

 
This change will not affect existing Classify nodes, which will retain their current model and behavior; makers can update these nodes to use the Decision model. 

 
What action do I need to take?

This message is for awareness, and no action is required.
